C02.signature: Analyst times checking, correction, requests, download and import separately from waiting; verified files or simulated delivery locate active burden. Assumes representative fabricated tasks within D1-C1–C4.

C03.signature: Coordinator-confirmed center/week identities govern export selection despite current metadata changes; attendance remains mutable. Predicts stable membership. Requires reliable intent, IDs, authorization and affordable reads within D1-C1–C4.
C03.reason: Members share selection authority and invariance. F03 leaves accepted-scope persistence/control unspecified; new versus equivalent is unresolved. F06 is an assumed input, not their operation.

C04.signature: Coordinator examines identity provenance/conflicts and explicitly unresolved weekly membership before accepting scope. Predicts fewer false approvals at added effort; shared omissions require independent evidence. Assumes affordable private/manual representation within D1-C1–C4.
C04.reason: Members share operational uncertainty and adjudication. F03/F06 supply review/source comparison; no stable-ID join repair is proposed. P004 adds a distinct historical prepopulation interaction.

C05.signature: Private service binds authorized requests to exact CSV artifacts and sends completion-triggered receipts. Predicts shorter retrieval delay, not necessarily less active work. Requires secure correlation/hooks within D1-C1–C4.
C05.reason: Agreed anchor family preserved: both add completion-to-retrieval signaling to repeat export.

C06.signature: Coordinator correction creates a new weekly-scope version reused until another explicit correction. Predicts late-omission recovery with repeatability. Requires trustworthy intent, identity and persistence within D1-C1–C4.
C06.reason: Versioned correction is explicit, but F03 does not specify how corrected preview scope persists; the frozen-manifest comparator cannot resolve archive novelty. F06 source diagnosis is not implemented.

C07.reason: Agreed anchor family preserved: captured edits determine review scope in both members.

C08.signature: Analyst crosses pinned/corrected membership with ordinary/immediate replacement. Predicts little incremental delivery benefit after correctness removes replacement demand. Assumes four representative brief conditions fit D1-C1–C4.
C08.reason: Substitution is the discriminator. Historical-assignment lookup from F01 is not specified; F03 supplies the recovery parent.

C09.signature: Analyst timestamps request, job start, completion and receipt plus active work to distinguish queue from delivery delay. Assumes observable private stages within D1-C1–C4; staging may misrepresent production queues.
C09.reason: Stage decomposition extends F05 timing. F03 proposes repeat export, not queue-versus-delivery diagnosis.

C10.signature: Analyst compares attendance-linked weekly course IDs with export selection; discrepancies reveal active-course omissions while zero-entry courses remain invisible. Requires preserved authorized identifiers within D1-C1–C4.
C10.reason: Agreed anchor preserved: historical activity is a partial independent witness with a specific zero-entry boundary.

C11.signature: Authorized coordinator confirms/corrects center/week course IDs and immediately reruns the existing exporter. Predicts shorter replacement waiting; handling benefit depends on request effort. Requires explicit-scope export/capacity within D1-C1–C4.
C11.reason: Matches F03 preview/repeat export. P003-A2 instead investigates labor using simulated delivery and defers this mechanism.

C12.signature: Attendance-selection discrepancies direct coordinator correction into authorized regeneration with unresolved coverage visible. Predicts less checking than reruns alone and fewer handoffs than detection alone. Requires both parents within D1-C1–C4; zero-entry omissions persist.
C12.reason: Agreed anchor preserved: detection routes correction with explicit comparisons against both parents.

C13.signature: Service binds scope approval to a revision and rechecks ownership/freshness at generation without freezing attendance. Predicts rejection after missed notifications. Requires dependable revisions and affordable checks within D1-C1–C4.
C13.reason: F04 matches generation-time ownership checking only; revision-bound freshness adds the stated discriminator.

C14.signature: Analyst tests exact-once split-week membership and foreign ownership using matching-label courses during attendance entry. Requires declared split intent and representative authorization paths within D1-C1–C4.
C14.reason: Exact-once and adversarial-label fixtures specialize F04/F06 checks. No F02 stable-identifier join operation is proposed.

C15.signature: Exporter compares emitted membership/ownership with a confirmed center/week manifest before release, rejecting foreign rows. Requires reliable expectations, ownership and nonblocking reads within D1-C1–C4.
C15.reason: Agreed anchor preserved: packing-list framing retains the expected-roster release gate.

C16.signature: Diagnosis routes recognition failures to private identity clarification and selection failures to corrected authorized reruns. Predicts fewer rename-only replacements. Requires accurate diagnosis and affordable correction; routing-only staging respects D1-C1–C4.
C16.reason: Agreed anchor preserved: diagnosed cause chooses the recovery operation.

C17.signature: Week-effective historical candidates prepopulate scope; coordinator discrepancy correction amends visible errors. Predicts less upkeep than manual manifests and fewer errors than history alone. Requires dated data and reliable correction within D1-C1–C4; shared omissions persist.
C17.reason: Distinct from C04: historical prepopulation supplies a causal input and both-parent discriminator, beyond recording unresolved decisions.
